what: The Worst page: PS2 games that critics scored lowest, by release region. Made by hand from public pages on 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-03; a partial list, not a ranking of every game. Scores come from different aggregators (Metacritic 0-100, GameRankings %), so the order within a list is only a rough guide. A game is listed under every region its Wikipedia page gives a PS2 release date for; Metacritic scores are not split by region, so a game released in both appears in both lists with the same score. No popular-vote ranking is included: none could be read. Add a game only with a source you read.

games.title: Little Britain: The Video Game
games.note: Eurogamer 1/10, PALGN 1.5/10. Released in Europe on 2 February 2007.

games.title: Gravity Games Bike: Street Vert. Dirt
games.note: PS2 Metascore 24 (Xbox 15). Released in North America on 27 June 2002 and in Europe on 27 September 2002.

games.title: Charlie's Angels
games.note: The PS2 version came out in Europe only (4 July 2003). Its famous Metacritic 23 is the GameCube version; no PS2 score was found.

games.title: GoDai: Elemental Force
games.note: IGN 2.5/10, GameSpot 3.3/10, GameSpy 17%. Released in North America on 21 January 2002 and in Europe on 1 March 2002.

games.title: MTV's Celebrity Deathmatch
games.note: Metacritic 32 for PS2, GameRankings 37%. North America 14 October 2003, Europe 31 October 2003 (the page does not label the dates by platform, so assigning them to PS2 is inferred).

games.title: Mike Tyson Heavyweight Boxing
games.note: GameSpot 2.5/10, IGN 2.6/10. PS2 released in Europe on 7 June 2002 and in North America on 26 June 2002.

games.title: McFarlane's Evil Prophecy
games.note: Released in North America on 15 June 2004 and in Europe on 15 October 2004.

games.title: Fugitive Hunter: War on Terror
games.note: Called America's 10 Most Wanted in Europe. North America 18 November 2003, Europe 6 August 2004.

games.title: Fight Club
games.note: Metacritic 36, GameRankings 36.84%. North America 16 November 2004, Europe 10 December 2004.

games.title: The Shield
games.note: Metacritic 36, GameRankings 38.10%. North America 9 January 2007, Europe 1 June 2007.

games.title: Fantastic 4: Rise of Silver Surfer
games.note: Metacritic 36, GameRankings 43.44%. North America 15 June 2007; the page's European date is ambiguous, so it is listed for the US only.

games.title: Aqua Teen Hunger Force: Zombie Ninja Pro-Am
games.note: Metacritic 37, GameRankings 42.06%. North America 5 November 2007, Europe 16 November 2007.

games.title: Crazy Frog Racer 2
games.note: PS2 Metascore 29 from 5 reviews; IGN 2.5/10. Wikipedia gives Europe late 2006 and North America 4 September 2007 for the game as a whole, not the PS2 version alone.

games.title: Simpsons Skateboarding
games.note: Many reviewers called it one of the weakest Simpsons games. Released in North America on 12 November 2002 and in Europe on 6 December 2002.

games.title: 25 to Life
games.note: PS2 Metascore 39: muddy graphics, confusing controls. Released in North America on 18 January 2006 and in Europe on 1 June 2007.

games.title: Final Armada
games.note: Metacritic calls the PS2 reviews generally unfavourable. Released only in Europe: Germany 4 May 2007, UK 14 September 2007.

games.title: Pimp My Ride
games.note: PS2 Metascore 36: weak physics, monotonous play. Released in North America on 21 November 2006; Wikipedia gives no European date for the PS2 version.

games.title: Lowrider
games.note: 1UP 1.5/10, IGN 4/10; Metacritic: generally unfavourable. Wikipedia lists North America 20 November 2003 and Japan 19 December 2002, with no European date.

games.title: Catwoman
games.note: PS2 Metascore 46: poor camera, weak voice acting, simple combat. Released in North America on 23 July 2004 and in Europe on 6 August 2004 (dates are for the game as a whole).

games.title: Sky Surfer
games.note: NextGen: 'so dull and listless that it almost defines the concept of duff launch software'. Released in Europe on 6 July 2001; Wikipedia gives no North American date.
